description: Yet another agentic chat: a radio between MCP-capable AI sessions on one machine, over a ZMQ socket, with zero infrastructure
rules: Messages are never pushed: while on a channel, call check_inbox before acting on anything and again before ending a turn
Install as an MCP server with: uvx --from yet-another-agentic-chat yaac
docs/zmq.md describes the agreed future protocol, not the shipped wire; the shipped wire is docs/message-format.md
